attempts.text:
I worked this out by hand and didn't run it through a solver. I compared the cost of each possible trip with the penalties it would avoid.

**Key facts**
- The only usable route to the far locations from the shelter is via Nilkantha temple: temple (31 min), Naukunda (86), then Galchhi (107), or Dhunche (107), Bidur school (119) and Shivapuri care home (139).
- Thakre village has nobody waiting, so it can be ignored.
- People can only be dropped off at Myagang shelter, so every trip is a round trip carrying at most 4 people.

**Value of each trip**

| Trip | Driving (min) | Penalties avoided | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Galchhi: 1 injured, 3 children | 214 | 260 | Worth it, saves 46 |
| Temple: 4 adults | 62 | 80 | Worth it, saves 18 |
| Temple: remaining 3 adults | 62 | 60 | Not worth it, costs 2 more |
| Bidur: 3 children, plus 1 adult at the temple on the way back | 238 | 200 | Not worth it, costs 38 more |
| Shivapuri, stopping at Bidur: 3 children, 1 elderly | 278 | 230 | Not worth it, costs 48 more |
| Shivapuri: 4 elderly | 278 | 200 | Not worth it, costs 78 more |

The best plan is therefore to run the first two trips and defer everyone else. This means the 3 children at Bidur school and the 4 elderly people at Shivapuri care home wait for a later wave, because reaching them costs more than their penalties under the scoring rules.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple
drive car1 nilkantha-temple naukunda-village
drive car1 naukunda-village galchhi-village
load car1 injured 1
load car1 child 3
drive car1 galchhi-village naukunda-village
drive car1 naukunda-village nilkantha-temple
drive car1 nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 child 3
drive car2 myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter
unload car2 adult 4
defer nilkantha-temple adult 3
defer bidur-school child 3
defer shivapuri-care-home elderly 4
</plan>

**Cost breakdown**
- **Driving:** 214 + 62 = 276
- **Penalties:** 3 adults (60) + 3 children (180) + 4 elderly (200) = 440
- **Total:** 276 + 440 = 716

COST: 716
